title: AI Travel Agent — Trace / Log / Metric correlation

options.content:
Local dev does not stand up Loki. The pino stdout of the API and
 worker containers already carries a `trace_id` field (see
 `apps/api/src/observability/telemetry.ts:62-85`). Run one of:

```bash
# Single container:
docker logs app 2>&1 | jq 'select(.trace_id == "${trace_id}")'

# Both API + Worker:
docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.observability.yml \
  logs --no-color 2>&1 | jq 'select(.trace_id == "${trace_id}")'
```

In production, the same `trace_id` is queryable in Grafana Cloud's
 Logs UI via `{job="ai-travel-agent-api"} | json | trace_id="${trace_id}"`.

Local dev does not stand up Mimir. The API exposes its registry on
 `GET /metrics` (Prometheus text). Useful snippets:

```bash
# All series:
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3000/metrics

# A single counter:
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3000/metrics | grep ^agent_skill_runs_total

# Latency histogram:
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3000/metrics | grep ^agent_task_duration_ms
```

In production, the same endpoint is scraped by Grafana Cloud Prometheus
 remote-write ingestion; SLO dashboards live in
 `docs/observability-slo.md`.
